text_block_list.text:
The northern land. Sapporo Racecourse.
Though the passing breeze was cool,
the heat in the venue carried a palpable intensity.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Is Desire okay...?"
"I just hope she doesn't push herself too hard..."
"For now, all we can do is pray that she's unharmed..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it.
The pure, pulsing beat of everyone's souls—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: For all your gentle kindness and concern for my well-being, I offer my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, there is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Saint Red Desire has made her second advent upon the turf—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And I shall prove it in this race.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That with this very soul, I held back the "Crimson Wedge"
and overcame the supreme trial—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, Desire's got a real presence today...!"
"Doesn't she look like she's in top condition...!?"
choice_data_list: (Everyone else can tell she's getting better too)

text_block_list.text:
A glimpse of the supernatural energy
radiating from Red Desire—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I was seriously shocked when I heard
you got a nosebleed at the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' pretty good, aren't ya?
Or rather, you're doing so good it's kinda crazy...

Tosen Jordan—
She shares the spotlight with Red Desire
in this Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san. Thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, no, cut that out.
It's not like I was trying to be thoughtful or anything."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If we don't go all out, what's the fun in that? Look, everyone's watching.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... Even the cool breeze of this northern land serves as the wind at my back now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Surely you feel it too, do you not?
The breath of the spirits pushing the Saint forward—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-What the...!? That aura is insane!!
Wait... doesn't the whole atmosphere around here feel weird too!?
The Saint is way too crazy...!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, but...
Still, that don't matter at all!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No matter what you throw at me, I'm gonna win!
I'll completely overpower you on the track, so brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—I, too, have eyes only for victory.
From the very moment I resolved to set foot upon this turf.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
To everyone who has supported me along the way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Saint Red Desire shall now depart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling completely reborn,
I take my first step into a whole new world...!!"
